name: core.openwop.workflows.finance
description: Real-work workflow pack (RFC 0013, ADR 0149) — the Finance cluster: Invoice → AP Processing, Month-End Close Checklist, and Expense/Budget Approval + anomaly detection. Reasons with core.ai.chatCompletion; recommends ERP actions (validation + posting) provider-agnostically via core.openwop.connectors.erp-action (NetSuite when connected); every posting/reimbursement runs through a threshold core.chat.approvalGate. All tenant-specific values are run parameters (replay-deterministic). Resolves on hosts shipping the http + ai + chat + kb + integration packs. Published under core.openwop.workflows.* (openwop-team key).
author: openwop

chains.label: Invoice → AP Processing
chains.description: Extract invoice line items, validate against the PO/ledger in the ERP (provider-agnostic), run a threshold-based approval, then post the invoice and send a payment notification.

erpBaseUrl.description: The ERP REST base (e.g. https://{account}.suitetalk.api.netsuite.com). Empty ⇒ recommend only.

vendorId.description: The ERP vendor id for a live vendor-bill post.

billAmount.description: The invoice amount for a live post.

invoiceText.description: The invoice content (extracted text or a description).

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Set it to fix a provider into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave it unset and each run uses the run's chosen provider, else the workspace's AI setting, else the host's catalog default (ADR 0903); whichever is chosen is recorded on the run, so a replay or fork uses the same one. The workspace needs a key for the provider that runs.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by the provider in the host catalog. Leave it unset to use the provider's model from the same choice (ADR 0903).

config.systemPrompt: Extract vendor, line items, amounts, and totals from the invoice. Invoice: {{params.invoiceText}}

config.title: Approve posting this invoice to the ERP

chains.label: Month-End Close Checklist
chains.description: Orchestrate the close: build the task checklist, collect supporting docs from the knowledge base, draft variance notes, chase missing approvals, then produce a close-readiness report.

orgId.description: Org whose knowledge base holds the supporting docs.

query.description: Supporting-docs search query (source node reads it from run inputs).

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Set it to fix a provider into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave it unset and each run uses the run's chosen provider, else the workspace's AI setting, else the host's catalog default (ADR 0903); whichever is chosen is recorded on the run, so a replay or fork uses the same one. The workspace needs a key for the provider that runs.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by the provider in the host catalog. Leave it unset to use the provider's model from the same choice (ADR 0903).

config.systemPrompt: Build the month-end close checklist for {{params.period}} across teams, with owners and dependencies.
Draft variance commentary for {{params.period}} from the checklist status and supporting docs; flag missing items.

chains.label: Expense / Budget Approval + Anomaly Detection
chains.description: Check an expense against policy, run a duplicate/anomaly check, route through a threshold approval chain, then reimburse via the ERP and flag outliers.

erpBaseUrl.description: The ERP REST base (e.g. https://{account}.suitetalk.api.netsuite.com). Empty ⇒ recommend only.

employeeId.description: The ERP employee id for a live expense-report post.

expenseAmount.description: The reimbursement amount for a live post.

expenseContext.description: The expense to assess (amount, category, submitter, notes).

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Set it to fix a provider into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave it unset and each run uses the run's chosen provider, else the workspace's AI setting, else the host's catalog default (ADR 0903); whichever is chosen is recorded on the run, so a replay or fork uses the same one. The workspace needs a key for the provider that runs.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by the provider in the host catalog. Leave it unset to use the provider's model from the same choice (ADR 0903).

config.systemPrompt: Assess the expense against policy and detect duplicates/anomalies. Expense: {{params.expenseContext}}

config.title: Approve reimbursing this expense via the ERP
